title: Flock Safety Event Log, May 15, 2026 to Present

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting the Flock Safety Event Log for the Chatham County Police Department’s Flock account, covering every organization or network in the account, from May 15, 2026, through the date of this request. This is the export of user and administrative actions with the columns Timestamp, User, Event Type, Entity Type, Entity Details, and Event ID. It is not the license plate search audit.

In priority order:

Every event other than live stream views, for example, network share changes (create, update, or delete), custom hotlist entries, recorded stream views, and stream downloads.
The live stream view events.
Any documentation from Flock or kept by the Department that explains the Event Log’s fields, event types, and entity types.

If item 2 is large or costly, please send items 1 and 3 first and give me the estimate for item 2. I am glad to narrow its date range or scope.

Please provide the log as a CSV or the platform’s native export so I can search it. If the platform limits the export size or period, please provide as many exports as needed to cover the whole period with no gaps, and tell me the first and last event date in each file. This includes records Flock Safety maintains for the Department. See O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(a)(2)(B).

If any part cannot be released, please tell me which part and the specific legal authority by Code section, subsection, and paragraph, as § 50-18-71(d) provides, and release the rest. I do not authorize any work that would exceed $25 until I have approved the estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ethan Watters

title: Gang Activity Prosecution (GAP) Grant: City of Savannah and Savannah Police Department, FY2024 and FY2025 (GEMA/HS)

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: Gang Activity Prosecution (GAP) Grant: City of Savannah and Savannah Police Department, FY2024 and FY2025 (GEMA/HS)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The application or applications submitted by the City of Savannah or the Savannah Police Department (as applicant, partner, or subrecipient) for the FY2024 and FY2025 Gang Activity Prosecution (GAP) Grant, and for any later GAP Grant cycle, including the project narrative, budget, budget narrative, equipment or software list, partner or prosecutor letters, and all attachments.
The award letter, grant agreement, special conditions, amendments, and budget modifications for each award to the City or the Department.

Records that identify facial recognition software or Clearview AI as an item budgeted, approved, purchased, or reimbursed under these awards, including approval requests, procurement or sole-source documentation, invoices, and reimbursement requests with supporting documents.

Progress, performance, and financial reports submitted for each award, including any reporting on facial recognition searches, arrests, or prosecutions, and any monitoring, site visit, audit, or closeout records.
Documents sufficient to show the amount awarded and the amount paid to the City or the Department under each award.

Correspondence between GEMA/HS and the City or the Department about Clearview AI, facial recognition, or the use of GAP funds for software subscriptions, from September 1, 2023 to the date of this request.

These records may be kept in the Georgia EM Grants Manager; please include records held there. If any responsive record is withheld in whole or in part, please identify the specific legal authority by Code section, subsection, and paragraph, as O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(d) provides, and produce all reasonably segregable portions. I do not authorize any work that would exceed $25 until I have approved the estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ethan Watters

title: Clearview AI: Email Content for Eight Selected Threads

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: Clearview AI: Email Content for Eight Selected Threads
communications.communication:

Please produce the complete content, including the message text, all replies and forwards, and all attachments, of the following email threads, from every City account that sent or received them:
